title: Event ticket refunds: the refund rule in two places
name: Ticket refund policy

questions.prompt: Support is getting angry emails from flex-ticket buyers. The My Tickets page says "Return now for €55.00 back" two days before the show, but pressing Return fails with "outside the refund window". Customers who return on the day get nothing, though the terms promise half. Standard tickets seem fine. Fix tickets/refunds.ts so the tests pass.
